thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 10/05/2018: MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, GPRO, SNAP

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 10/05/2018: MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, GPRO, SNAP
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: Flat
AAPL: -0.04%
IBM: -0.04%
CSCO: -0.27%
GOOG: -0.2%
Technology stocks were almost flat pre-market Friday.
Movers include:
(+) GoPro ( GPRO ) was trading above 7% after its HERO7 Black model achieved the highest week-one retail unit sell-thru of any new camera in the company's history.
(+) Snap ( SNAP ) was up more than 3% following reports that CEO Evan Spiegel outlined a set of goals aimed at attaining full-year profitability next year as the camera and technology company seeks to resolve a decline in the number of users.
